// diagnostic

E0122

The copy marks for `{file}` do not parse, so `{file}` was left unchanged

What

The copy marks for `{file}` do not parse, so `{file}` was left unchanged

Why

`jet fmt --explicit-copies` places `~` at the copy sites the checker reports; a site that yields unparseable source is a defect in the copy-site data, not in your code, which checks clean.

Fix

Report the file to the Jet maintainers; format without `--explicit-copies` until the fix lands.
